headline: Good Morning World》IMF Estimates Taiwan's Economic Growth Above 10% This Year, First in Asia-Pacific, Rare Double-Digit Growth Globally | Lifestyle
summary: The IMF's latest global forecast raised Taiwan's real GDP growth to 10.7% from 5.2% in April. Taiwan is the only major economy in the outlook with a double-digit upgrade.
why: The IMF's World Economic Outlook is a widely watched benchmark for global growth, and revisions to individual economies shape investor views on regional demand.
